title: Experts disagree on upgrade nudge link
context:
Chief architect: Complementary constraints on the same link, not a contradiction: it is informational-only and never checkout (market-researcher) AND it carries only a static campaign tag with disclosure (security-auditor). The spec applies both. No owner decision is needed.

Target: upgrade nudge link
- security-auditor: The nudge link carries only a static campaign tag and no per-user, per-repo or per-answer identifier; data minimisation must hold and the tag must be disclosed in README and docs/privacy-policy.md.
- market-researcher: The nudge may link to an informational page only and never to checkout, to satisfy both stores' directory rules.
